title: TextField Widget
subtitle: Accept text inputs from the user with custom decorations and keyboard types.

properties.name: controller
properties.description: An object that controls the text being edited, allowing you to read or pre-fill text programmatically.

properties.name: decoration
properties.description: Configures input styling, borders, colors, placeholder text, and leading/trailing icons.

properties.name: keyboardType
properties.description: Configures which virtual keyboard layout to present to the user (text, numbers, email, etc.).

properties.name: obscureText
properties.description: Whether to hide the characters being typed (most commonly used for passwords).
